newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange rises in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange rises in moderate trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange index rose on Wednesday, buoyed by Mobil Ghana Oil Ghana Limited, up 100 cedis to 6,100 cedis.
The Ghana All-Share index rose by 0.65 point to 370.79 from 370.14 on Monday.
Trade was moderate, with 51,700 shares changing hands and bids outstripping offers by 5,373,100 to 317,660.
The other advancing issues were Social Security Bank, up five to 1270, and Unilever, up three to 851.
